people.name: Andrew Huberman

molecules.name: Insulin
molecules.role: Master 'storage' hormone — lowers blood glucose by driving GLUT4 translocation in muscle/adipose; suppresses hepatic glucose production; drives lipogenesis

molecules.name: Glucagon
molecules.role: Counter-regulatory hormone that raises blood glucose via hepatic glycogenolysis + gluconeogenesis; inversely paired with insulin

molecules.name: GLP-1 (Glucagon-Like Peptide 1)
molecules.role: Gut-derived incretin released after meals — potentiates glucose-dependent insulin secretion, slows gastric emptying, suppresses glucagon and appetite (target of semaglutide/tirzepatide)

molecules.name: GIP (Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Peptide)
molecules.role: Primary incretin in the upper gut — stimulates insulin secretion post-meal; partner to GLP-1 (tirzepatide is dual GLP-1/GIP agonist)

molecules.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
molecules.label_th: ฮีโมโกลบิน เอ วัน ซี / น้ำตาลสะสม
molecules.role: Reflects average blood glucose over ~2-3 months; ADA diabetes cutoff ≥6.5%; each 1% = ~28.7 mg/dL mean glucose (ADAG equation)

molecules.name: C-peptide
molecules.role: Secreted 1:1 with endogenous insulin — marker of β-cell function; distinguishes endogenous vs exogenous insulin

molecules.name: Glucose
molecules.role: Primary circulating sugar; normal fasting 70-99 mg/dL; postprandial should stay <140 mg/dL at 2h (ADA)

molecules.name: Fructose
molecules.role: Sugar metabolized almost exclusively in liver via fructolysis (bypasses PFK regulation) → drives hepatic de novo lipogenesis, uric acid, NAFLD

molecules.name: GLUT4
molecules.role: Insulin-responsive transporter in muscle/adipose — translocates from intracellular vesicles to plasma membrane upon insulin binding

molecules.name: Glucokinase (hexokinase IV)
molecules.label_th: กลูโคไคเนส
molecules.role: Glucose sensor of liver and β-cell — phosphorylates glucose→G6P at rates proportional to blood glucose; 'setpoint' enzyme of insulin secretion

molecules.name: Berberine
molecules.label_th: เบอร์เบอรีน
molecules.role: Activates AMPK; inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis; improves insulin sensitivity — comparable HbA1c reduction to metformin in head-to-head RCT

molecules.name: Metformin
molecules.label_th: เมทฟอร์มิน
molecules.role: First-line T2D therapy — inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis via AMPK activation + mitochondrial complex I inhibition; also acts on gut microbiome

molecules.name: Semaglutide
molecules.label_th: เซมากลูไทด์ (Ozempic/Wegovy)
molecules.role: Long-acting GLP-1 mimetic — -14.9% body weight at 68 w (STEP-1); also approved for T2D + cardiovascular risk reduction

molecules.name: Chromium (as picolinate)
molecules.role: Essential cofactor in the chromodulin complex that amplifies insulin receptor signaling; supplementation modestly improves glycemia in suboptimal-chromium populations

molecules.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid (ALA)
molecules.label_th: อัลฟา-ไลโปอิก แอซิด
molecules.role: Mitochondrial cofactor of pyruvate dehydrogenase; improves insulin sensitivity; used in Europe for diabetic neuropathy (ALADIN trials)

molecules.name: Myo-Inositol + D-Chiro Inositol
molecules.role: Precursor of inositol phosphoglycans — second messengers of insulin signaling; 40:1 myo:DCI ratio improves IR in PCOS and T2D

molecules.name: Cinnamon / MHCP (methylhydroxychalcone polymer)
molecules.role: Polyphenol from Cinnamomum spp. — activates insulin receptor autophosphorylation in vitro; modest glucose lowering in RCTs

molecules.name: Acetic Acid (from vinegar)
molecules.label_th: กรดอะซีติก / น้ำส้มสายชู
molecules.role: Delays gastric emptying; inhibits α-amylase → blunts postprandial glucose ~20-34% when taken with a carb meal (Johnston 2004; meta-analyses)

molecules.name: Glucomannan (konjac fiber)
molecules.label_th: กลูโคแมนแนน
molecules.role: Gel-forming fiber that slows carb absorption, blunts postprandial glucose, and increases satiety via GLP-1 release

molecules.name: Cortisol
molecules.role: Circadian stress hormone peaking 4-8 AM — promotes hepatic gluconeogenesis, drives the dawn phenomenon; chronic elevation worsens insulin resistance

molecules.name: Growth Hormone (GH)
molecules.label_th: โกรทฮอร์โมน
molecules.role: Nocturnal pulsatile hormone — stimulates lipolysis and raises blood glucose at night via hepatic IGF-1 axis; contributes to dawn phenomenon

case_studies.name: DiRECT Trial (Lean et al. 2018)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Cluster-randomized trial in UK primary care — 46% of T2D patients achieved remission at 12 months on an 825-853 kcal/day total diet replacement (TDR); 64% of those losing ≥10 kg achieved remission; 36% sustained remission at 2 years, ~11% at 5 years
case_studies.source: Lean MEJ et al., Lancet 2018; 5-year follow-up: Thom G et al., Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2024

case_studies.name: Counterpoint Study (Lim et al. 2011)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 11 T2D patients on 600 kcal/day for 8 weeks — fasting plasma glucose normalized within 7 days; pancreatic β-cell first-phase insulin response recovered over 8 weeks — proof-of-concept for the Twin Cycle Hypothesis

case_studies.name: STEP-1 Semaglutide Obesity Trial (Wilding et al. 2021)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 1,961 adults with obesity, 68 weeks — semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly produced mean weight loss of 14.9% vs 2.4% placebo; 86% achieved ≥5% weight loss

case_studies.name: UKPDS (UK Prospective Diabetes Study)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 20-year landmark T2D trial (n=5,102) — intensive glucose control (HbA1c ~7% vs ~7.9%) reduced microvascular complications by 25%; long-term follow-up showed 'legacy effect' on CV mortality
case_studies.source: UKPDS Group, Lancet 1998 + NEJM 10-year follow-up 2008 (Holman RR et al.)
